There are many '''guards''' in [[Gielinor]], usually in populated, major cities, such as [[Falador]], [[Varrock]], [[Ardougne]], and others. Guards also patrol the area just south of the [[wilderness ditch]] at [[Edgeville]].

Their [[Combat level|level]] ranges from 19-22, and they are quite weak. None of the guards are [[Aggressiveness|aggressive]] unless attacked first. Guards can be pickpocketed at level 40 [[Thieving]], giving 46.8 [[experience]] and 30 [[coins]]. Besides the ones listed on this page, other guards whose pockets can be picked include the [[Guard (Port Sarim jail)|Port Sarim jail guards]], [[Guard (Hosidius)|Hosidius guards]], [[Guard (Shayzien)|Shayzien guards]], along with the [[Guard (Doric's hut)|guard]] loitering east of [[Doric's hut]].

A large variety of guards exist in addition to the ones that can be robbed, like for example the unique [[Guard (Deadman Mode)|level 1337 guards]] found in [[Deadman mode]], who will kill anyone who enters a safe zone while [[Skull (status)|skulled]] instantly.

Guards are a popular source of [[clue scroll]]s due to their low level and ability to drop [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium clue scrolls]]. Completing the [[Falador Diary#Medium|medium Falador Diary]] allows the player to have a 20% increased chance of receiving a clue scroll drop from guards in Falador.

==Pickpocketing==
A way to efficiently thieve from Guards is to complete the [[Recruitment Drive]] [[Quests|quest]], set Falador as one's [[Spawning|spawn point]], and then pickpocket Falador guards until inevitably dying in the process. Upon death, it is possible to run straight back and pick up any coins that one died with.

==Trivia==
*Edgeville and Falador guards had festive overrides wearing [[santa hat]]s during the [[2021 Christmas event/Gallery|2021]], [[2023 Christmas event/Gallery|2023]], [[2024 Christmas event/Gallery|2024]], and [[2025 Christmas event/Gallery|2025]] Christmas events.
*The crossbow-wielding guards of Falador use the [[Karil's crossbow]] animation when firing.
*The Falador Guard scene from [[Garden of Tranquillity]], in which the short lifespan of a Falador Guard is discussed, is a reference to The Royal Flying Corp episodes of Blackadder Goes Forth.{{Citation needed}}
*Guards in [[Varrock]] used to wear unique armour and weapons that mirrored those of a [[Renegade knight]], but have since been given models reminiscent of an older art style, while retaining the yellow and grey colours of the city they protect.
